meta.policy: System-verified motif provenance registry. Maps a motif to the worldId that owns it. This file is code-owned and can NEVER be authored into a story-bible.json: a bible must not be able to whitelist foreign motifs for itself. Seeded from rendered use-site evidence plus human review of cross-book conflicts; extending it is a code change, not a bible change.
meta.lookupOrder: origins[motif] wins over shared-generic-motifs.json; unknown motifs fall back to scene-local grounding (VOCABULARY_NOT_GROUNDED).
